aboutParagraphs: Sample Heating & Air started in 2008 with one truck and a simple idea: show up when you say you will, explain the problem in plain English, and charge a fair price you agree to before the work starts.

Today our small team handles furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps and ductwork for homes across Bloomington and Monroe County, from century-old houses near downtown to new builds out in the county. Most of our work comes from neighbors who recommend us, and we'd like to keep it that way.
Whether it's a no-heat call on a January night or a new system for a home you just bought, you'll talk to people who live here and care about getting it right.
